## Imported Education-Initiatives overview

This section preserves the source project's editorial record. Its evidence classification and tags are curated assessments, not additional experimental findings; historical period labels are not verified exact dates. Method tags describe the imported record and do not classify the entire mixed-design impact study as randomized.

Fund scientifically based reading instruction and assessment systems in high-poverty schools.

### Inputs changed

Reading coaches, PD, K-3 curricula, assessment, instructional time

### Target population

K-3 students in participating schools

### Evaluation designs

Regression discontinuity; randomized component; implementation study

### Method tags

RCT; Regression discontinuity

mixed-conditional

### Outcomes measured

Reading comprehension, decoding, instruction time, teacher practice

### Interpretation limits

The evaluation tests the federal grant implementation, not the National Reading Panel findings themselves.

### Imported summary

Improved some reading instruction measures but did not produce clear broad comprehension gains in the national impact study.
